messages:
Priya (Solutions): Heads-up: Marlin signed an LOI, they want a 1-week POC to validate migration from their current provider. Main asks: API surface mapping, prompt/response diffs, and pricing run-rate. Can we scope?
Evan (SE): We can do a compatibility shim and a verification harness. Need their request/response examples + model IDs. Any hard constraints?
CTO-Rep (Customer): Main blockers: SSO/SAML, on-prem hosting option, and token accounting for billing parity. Also worried about subtle output differences breaking our UX.
Jon (Eng): Note: tokenization differences often cause small output shifts. We'll capture token counts and special tokens. Also recommend enforcing structured response via function-calling to reduce diffs.
Mira (Sales): Timeline: they want a demo next Tue. Can Solutions + Eng confirm POC plan by EOD so I can lock the calendar?
Priya (Solutions): Draft plan: 1) run canonical prompt set (they'll provide 50 prompts) 2) compare output diffs + tokenization 3) implement shim mapping for response fields 4) run perf & cost estimation. Olivia — we'll need prefilled security questionnaire for on-prem ask.
Olivia (Legal): Send the SIG/infosec questionnaire now and we'll prefill. For on-prem, Redwood Private supports KMS and an offline install path — need to confirm inbound/outbound network rules.
CTO-Rep (Customer): Can you avoid storing user prompts? Our compliance requires no persisted prompt logs.
Evan (SE): We have a stateless mode: disable telemetry and prompt persistence; metrics still collected but can be aggregated. I'll add an opt-out flag for the sandbox. For billing parity: if tokenizers differ we'll provide a mapping and a run-rate estimate.
Jon (Eng): Quick shim test curl (example): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"prompt":"Translate to French: Hello","max_tokens":128, "compat":"marlin-v1"}'
```
The `compat` param will normalize response shape and set deterministic sampling for parity checks.
Priya (Solutions): Please also produce a 5-item risk list (behavior drift, tokenization mismatch, streaming differences, latency delta, billing divergence). I'll add it to the POC SOW.
Evan (SE): :thumbsup: I'll draft the risk list + remediation and attach a sample compare script (diff + basic BLEU-like scoring).
Mira (Sales): I'll tell them we can run in a sandbox with sample data. One thing: POC credit vs committed pricing — Finance, what's the usual stance?
deploy-bot: POC sandbox created: marlin-sandbox-1775. Credentials sent to Priya via DM.
Priya (Solutions): Received creds. CTO-Rep, please upload the 50 prompts to the sandbox or send as CSV.
CTO-Rep (Customer): Uploaded CSV to the sandbox and attached expected outputs for 10 prompts.
Jon (Eng): Starting first-pass compare now against marlin-v1 outputs. I'll post quick findings here.
Evan (SE): Also flagging SAML cert exchange — Olivia, can Legal share the template? Their IT wants minimal changes.
Olivia (Legal): Sharing redacted SAML metadata template now: https://internal.redwood/sig-templates/saml-upload
Jon (Eng): First-pass summary: 50 prompts -> 47 matched intent, 3 had structural JSON mismatches (array vs object). Those 3 can be shimmed without model changes. Latency within ~8% of their SLA target.
Priya (Solutions): Great. Mira: propose a 1-week POC SOW with objectives, deliverables (comparison report, shim code, cost estimate), and success criteria (>=95% intent match + <=10% cost delta).
Mira (Sales): On it — will send draft in ~2 hours. Quick Q: include rollback + fallback policy as part of deliverables?
Evan (SE): Yes, include fallback: route unmatched prompts back to their current provider for a 48hr window while we tune the shim.
CTO-Rep (Customer): That fallback is acceptable. Also — what's Dedicated pricing if we move to steady throughput after POC?
Priya (Solutions): Finance will provide exact numbers, but rough ballpark: dedicated starts at $X/month depending on GPU pool size. Mira will add exact tiers to the SOW.
Jon (Eng): Uploading preliminary diff artifacts to the sandbox under /artifacts/compare-1775. Will link in thread after upload.
Evan (SE): I'll prep the compare script and a short runbook for the SRE handoff.
Priya (Solutions): Thanks team — if we get the SOW and risk list today we can lock the demo and have Legal review the SAML flow before their IT call tomorrow.
Mira (Sales): Draft SOW sent (link DM). Scheduling demo for Tue 10am PT.
CTO-Rep (Customer): Confirmed. Looking forward to the demo.
Jon (Eng): Final note: small behavioral diffs mostly around punctuation and list formatting. Shim handles it, logging these cases for later model tuning.
Priya (Solutions): Perfect. Closing loop here — will attach final POC checklist + acceptance criteria to the SOW.
